fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The index seeks to offer exposure to market volatility through publicly traded futures markets and is designed to measure the implied volatility of the S&P 500 over 30 days in the future.

news.paragraph: Recent articles discuss intraday trading strategies for the UVXY ETF and its role as a leveraged volatility play for uncertain times. While one article from March suggests that "good things do not last" for UVXY, another from February highlights its utility in volatile periods. The ETF is positioned as a tool for short-term speculation on VIX spikes rather than a long-term investment.
